The '''Sisters of the Void''', also known as the '''Voidsisters''' were three sisters who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:SistersOfTheVoid-SWG.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Zombie/Legends|Undeads]] [[Witches of Dathomir]].]]
Following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]] on Dathomir, a number of members of the Dathomiri [[Howling Crag Clan]] became infected with the disease and in an attempt to contain the outbreak, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the clan. However three of the infected witches, [[Denkra Kymeri]], [[Naija Kymeri]] and [[Thestriel Kymeri]], survived by using spells to fight off the contagion. They became known as the "Sisters of the Void", assuming the names "Voidsister Warrior", "Voidsister Huntress" and "Voidsister Spellweaver" respectively. Furthermore, the three sisters developed the ability to reanimate the corpses of dead [[Witches of Dathomir]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and control them in battles.

However, the sisters gradually began to lose their battle against the infection, and the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of their mother, [[Amaya Kymeri]], sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill the trio.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sisters of the Void were created for the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and added to the game in December [[2010]], as part of the "Witches of Dathomir Theme Park" quest series.
